description: A list converted to a set type gets defaults, then its elements are unified to one type
notes: The README allows any in function TypeConstraint only, while convert-with-defaults reads its type with TypeConstraintWithDefaults (native/type-expressions/defaults-default-for-any), and doesn't say that a null attribute gets its default (native/type-expressions/defaults-null-attribute). hashicorp/hcl gives the element whose a is null the default 1, which keeps its number type because a's type is any, then unifies the elements (unifyAsSlice in ext/typeexpr/defaults.go), which turns 1 into "1" to match the other element's string.
